svg.title: QuotaPeek
svg.desc: QuotaPeek: Menu-bar quota viewer. Shows 5-hour and 7-day usage from VM2API or endpoints matching its /v1/usage schema, with profiles, alerts and Keychain-held keys. Swift · SwiftUI · AppKit. macOS 14+.
